note: Hand-curated energy analysis of HB2, New Hampshire's omnibus budget policy trailer, for the 2021, 2023, and 2025 budget cycles. Candidates came from relevance-term matching over every extracted section (see working/.../hb2/{year}/); a human pass kept the energy sections, added one section the matcher missed (flagged hand_added), and logged every exclusion. This analysis REVERSES the sibling packets' curation: the energy and utility sections they excluded with documented reasons are the core here, and their education/tax sections are excluded. Roll-call votes are recorded on HB2 AS A WHOLE - a vote for or against the trailer is never a vote on one section, and must not be presented as one.

relevant_sections.heading: Department of Administrative Services; Funding and Staffing Resource Limitations
relevant_sections.plain_language: Let the Department of Administrative Services suspend, for the biennium, its executive-order obligations to identify energy-efficiency projects in state facilities and to track state buildings' and vehicles' energy use, fossil-fuel consumption, and greenhouse-gas emissions.

relevant_sections.heading: Issuance of Electric Rate Reduction Bonds; 2027
relevant_sections.plain_language: Extended electric rate reduction bond authority to 2027 (RSA 369-B:5): the securitization tool that let utilities refinance stranded costs - the statute later used for storm-cost and divestiture financing that ratepayers repay on their bills.

relevant_sections.heading: New Chapter; Department of Energy
relevant_sections.plain_language: Created the Department of Energy (new RSA 12-P): a cabinet agency absorbing most Public Utilities Commission staff and functions plus the old Office of Strategic Initiatives' energy programs - the biggest restructuring of New Hampshire energy regulation since electric restructuring, moving policy, ratepayer advocacy support, and program administration out of the utility tribunal.

relevant_sections.heading: Department of Energy; Interim Commissioner
relevant_sections.plain_language: Let the Governor appoint an interim energy commissioner ahead of the department's full stand-up.

relevant_sections.heading: Repeals
relevant_sections.plain_language: The companion repeals: struck the Office of Strategic Initiatives' energy-planning statutes (including its offshore wind industry office) whose functions moved into the new department.

relevant_sections.heading: Organization of the Executive Branch
relevant_sections.plain_language: Added the Department of Energy to the executive-branch organization statute.

relevant_sections.heading: Department of Energy; Unclassified Positions Established
relevant_sections.plain_language: Established the department's unclassified leadership positions (commissioner, deputy, division directors).

relevant_sections.heading: Public Utilities Commission; Unclassified Positions Established
relevant_sections.plain_language: Re-established the slimmed-down Public Utilities Commission's unclassified positions after the staff transfer.

relevant_sections.heading: Name Change; Department of Energy
relevant_sections.plain_language: Renamed statutory references from the old offices to the Department of Energy.

relevant_sections.heading: Reference Changed: State Energy Strategy; Offshore Wind Commission
relevant_sections.plain_language: Moved the 10-year state energy strategy and the offshore wind commission references from the Office of Strategic Initiatives to the new department.

relevant_sections.heading: Reference Changed; State Energy Policy; Least Cost Energy Planning
relevant_sections.plain_language: Moved the least-cost energy planning policy reference to the new department.

relevant_sections.heading: Public Utilities Commission; Commission; Term
relevant_sections.plain_language: Rewrote the Public Utilities Commission itself: three full-time commissioners on staggered six-year terms, nominated through a screening process - the leaner adjudicative tribunal left after the department split.

relevant_sections.heading: Repeal
relevant_sections.plain_language: Repealed the old PUC organizational provisions superseded by the rewrite.

relevant_sections.heading: Public Utilities Commission; Prohibition on Future Employment
relevant_sections.plain_language: Barred PUC commissioners from taking employment with any utility the commission regulates for one year after leaving office - a revolving-door restriction on the state's utility regulators.

relevant_sections.heading: Public Utilities Commission; Quorum
relevant_sections.plain_language: Set the two-commissioner quorum rule for the restructured commission.

relevant_sections.heading: Public Utilities Commission; Request for Full Commission
relevant_sections.plain_language: Let parties request that the full commission hear a case.

relevant_sections.heading: Repeal
relevant_sections.plain_language: Repealed superseded PUC hearing-officer provisions.

relevant_sections.heading: Public Utilities Commission; Staff
relevant_sections.plain_language: Authorized the restructured commission's own staff (general counsel and hearings personnel).

relevant_sections.heading: Office of the Consumer Advocate; Attachment to Department of Energy
relevant_sections.plain_language: Kept the Office of the Consumer Advocate - the ratepayers' lawyer in utility cases - independent, administratively attached to the new Department of Energy rather than the commission.

relevant_sections.heading: Office of the Consumer Advocate; Attachment to Department of Energy
relevant_sections.plain_language: Companion attachment and staffing provisions for the consumer advocate's office.

relevant_sections.heading: Repeal
relevant_sections.plain_language: Repealed superseded PUC staffing statutes.

relevant_sections.heading: Public Utilities Commission; Complaints
relevant_sections.plain_language: Split complaint-handling between the new department and the commission.

relevant_sections.heading: Electric Vehicle Charging Stations Infrastructure Commission; Membership
relevant_sections.plain_language: Reconstituted the electric vehicle charging stations infrastructure commission's membership around the new department.

relevant_sections.heading: Electric Vehicle Charging Stations Infrastructure Commission; Duties
relevant_sections.plain_language: Rewrote that commission's duties: planning the build-out of EV charging infrastructure along state corridors.

relevant_sections.heading: Maintenance of Funds Collected Pursuant to Electric Utility Restructuring Orders
relevant_sections.plain_language: Moved custody of funds collected under electric utility restructuring orders (rate-settlement money) to the new department's oversight.

relevant_sections.heading: Energy Efficiency and Clean Energy Districts
relevant_sections.plain_language: Moved the commercial property assessed clean energy (C-PACE) districts' technical standards from the PUC to the department - the financing tool for building-efficiency retrofits.

relevant_sections.heading: Energy Efficiency and Sustainable Energy Board; Membership
relevant_sections.plain_language: Reconstituted the Energy Efficiency and Sustainable Energy (EESE) board - the standing stakeholder board on efficiency and clean-energy policy - around the new department.

relevant_sections.heading: State Building Code Review Board; Membership
relevant_sections.plain_language: Put the new department on the state building code review board, where the energy code lives.

relevant_sections.heading: Nuclear Decommissioning Financing Committee; Membership
relevant_sections.plain_language: Reconstituted the nuclear decommissioning financing committee (the body assuring Seabrook's decommissioning money) with the new department.

relevant_sections.heading: Conduct of Studies Concerning Changes in Laws and Regulations with a View to Atomic Development
relevant_sections.plain_language: Moved the atomic-development law-and-regulation study duty to the department.

relevant_sections.heading: New Hampshire Building Code; Energy Code Compliance Form
relevant_sections.plain_language: Moved the simplified residential energy code compliance form's rulemaking to the building code review board with department input.

relevant_sections.heading: Organization of Nuclear Decommissioning Financing Committees
relevant_sections.plain_language: Conforming reorganization of the nuclear decommissioning financing committee.

relevant_sections.heading: Decommissioning of Nuclear Electric Generating Facilities; Report; Public Hearing
relevant_sections.plain_language: Conforming change to decommissioning reports and public hearings for nuclear generating facilities.

relevant_sections.heading: Site Evaluation Committee; Membership; Administrative Attachment
relevant_sections.plain_language: Restructured the Site Evaluation Committee - the body that approves or rejects large energy facilities like transmission lines and wind plants - shrinking it and attaching it administratively to the new department.

relevant_sections.heading: Committee Established
relevant_sections.plain_language: Created a study committee on further revisions to the Site Evaluation Committee - the opening move in the siting-reform fight that continued all period.

relevant_sections.heading: Minimum Energy Efficiency Standards for Certain Products; Definitions
relevant_sections.plain_language: Moved the minimum energy efficiency standards for products (appliance standards) to the department.

relevant_sections.heading: Reference Change; Minimum Energy Efficiency Standards for Certain Products; Department
relevant_sections.plain_language: Companion reference change for the appliance efficiency standards.

relevant_sections.heading: Gas Companies; When Public Utilities
relevant_sections.plain_language: Conforming change to when gas companies (including pipeline operators) are regulated as public utilities.

relevant_sections.heading: New Paragraph; Limited Electrical Energy Producers Act; Definitions
relevant_sections.plain_language: Added a department definition to the Limited Electrical Energy Producers Act - the net-metering statute's framework.

relevant_sections.heading: Reference Change; Net Energy Metering; Department of Energy
relevant_sections.plain_language: Conforming reference change moving net energy metering administration to the department.

relevant_sections.heading: Net Energy Metering
relevant_sections.plain_language: Rewrote the group-host net metering rules (RSA 362-A:9, XIV): how a customer-generator hosts a group of customers and how hosts register and report - the mechanics that community solar projects run on.

relevant_sections.heading: Repeal
relevant_sections.plain_language: Repealed a superseded net-metering provision.

relevant_sections.heading: Electric Renewable Energy Classes; Reference Changed
relevant_sections.plain_language: Conforming reference changes to the electric renewable energy classes.

relevant_sections.heading: Electric Renewable Energy Classes; Reference Change
relevant_sections.plain_language: Conforming reference change to the renewable energy classes.

relevant_sections.heading: Renewable Energy Certificates
relevant_sections.plain_language: Moved renewable energy certificate administration to the department.

relevant_sections.heading: Electric Renewable Portfolio Standard; Information Collection; Reference Change
relevant_sections.plain_language: Moved renewable portfolio standard information collection to the department.

relevant_sections.heading: Electric Renewable Portfolio Standard; Renewable Energy Fund
relevant_sections.plain_language: Rewrote the renewable energy fund statute (RSA 362-F:10): the alternative-compliance-payment money that funds rebates and low-income solar programs is continually appropriated to the new department.

relevant_sections.heading: References Change; Electric Renewable Portfolio Standards; Department of Energy
relevant_sections.plain_language: Conforming reference changes across the renewable portfolio standard.

relevant_sections.heading: Expenses of the Public Utilities Commission Against Certain Utilities
relevant_sections.plain_language: Rewrote how the state charges utilities for their own regulation: the expenses of the commission and the new department are assessed against the utilities they regulate.

relevant_sections.heading: Expenses of Public Utilities Commission Against Certain Utilities; Assessment
relevant_sections.plain_language: The assessment formula itself: each public utility is assessed its share of regulatory costs based on gross revenue from New Hampshire customers - the funding backbone for both agencies, which flows into rates.

relevant_sections.heading: Expenses of Public Utilities Commission Against Certain Utilities; Certification of Assessment; Collection
relevant_sections.plain_language: Certification and collection mechanics for the utility assessment.

relevant_sections.heading: Public Utility Recovery of Assessment Costs
relevant_sections.plain_language: Let utilities recover the assessment costs in rates (default service and delivery charges) - the section that passes regulatory costs to ratepayers.

relevant_sections.heading: Complaints to and Proceedings Before the Department of Energy and the Commission
relevant_sections.plain_language: Conforming split of complaint and proceeding jurisdiction between the department and the commission.

relevant_sections.heading: Complaint Against Public Utilities
relevant_sections.plain_language: Rewrote who may complain against a public utility and where the complaint goes.

relevant_sections.heading: Complaints to the Department of Energy and Proceedings Before the Commission
relevant_sections.plain_language: Routed customer complaints to the department, with adjudication before the commission.

relevant_sections.heading: Proceedings Before the Public Utilities Commission
relevant_sections.plain_language: Conforming change to commission proceeding rules.

relevant_sections.heading: Proceedings Before the Public Utilities Commission
relevant_sections.plain_language: Conforming change to commission proceeding rules.

relevant_sections.plain_language: Repealed a superseded proceedings provision.

relevant_sections.heading: Complaints to Department of Energy and Public Utilities Commission; Expense of Investigations; Rate Proceeding

relevant_sections.heading: Complaints to Department of Energy and Public Utilities Commission; Penalty Against Utility
relevant_sections.plain_language: Conforming change to the civil-penalty statute for utilities, enforceable through the new department.

relevant_sections.heading: Affiliates of Public Utilities; Department of Energy

relevant_sections.heading: References Change; Service Equipment of Public Utilities; Department of Energy
relevant_sections.plain_language: Conforming reference changes for utility service-equipment regulation.

relevant_sections.heading: Service Equipment of Public Utilities; Units of Service
relevant_sections.plain_language: Conforming change to units-of-service rules for utility equipment.

relevant_sections.heading: Service Equipment of Public Utilities; Department of Energy
relevant_sections.plain_language: Conforming change assigning service-equipment oversight to the department.

relevant_sections.heading: Rights in Public Waters and Lands; License by Notification of New Attachments on Existing Utility Poles
relevant_sections.plain_language: Streamlined licenses for new attachments on existing utility poles and conduits over public waters and lands (license by notification).

relevant_sections.heading: Rights in Public Waters and Lands; Hearing; Order
relevant_sections.plain_language: Companion hearing-and-order rules for those public-waters utility licenses.

relevant_sections.heading: References Changed; Proceedings to Acquire Property or Rights; Rights in Public Waters and Lands; Department of Energy

relevant_sections.heading: Extent of Power
relevant_sections.plain_language: Conforming change to the extent of regulatory power over utilities.

relevant_sections.heading: Supervisory Power of Department of Energy and Public Utilities Commission
relevant_sections.plain_language: Split supervisory power over utilities between the department and the commission.

relevant_sections.heading: Duties
relevant_sections.plain_language: Rewrote the general duties statute for utility oversight between the two agencies.

relevant_sections.heading: Investigation of Other Utilities; Orders; Violation
relevant_sections.plain_language: Moved investigation of non-jurisdictional utilities and violation orders to the department.

relevant_sections.heading: Public Utilities; Reports; Filing
relevant_sections.plain_language: Utility reports now filed with the department.

relevant_sections.heading: Public Utilities; Reports
relevant_sections.plain_language: Companion utility reporting change.

relevant_sections.heading: Service Territories; Department of Energy Jurisdiction
relevant_sections.plain_language: Moved utility service-territory jurisdiction to the department.

relevant_sections.heading: Pole Attachments
relevant_sections.plain_language: Moved pole attachment regulation (the rates and terms for wires on utility poles) to the commission with department participation.

relevant_sections.heading: Repeals
relevant_sections.plain_language: Repealed superseded utility-regulation provisions.

relevant_sections.heading: Investigation of Accidents
relevant_sections.plain_language: Moved utility accident investigation to the department.

relevant_sections.heading: New Paragraph; Definitions
relevant_sections.plain_language: Added the department to the underground utility damage prevention (Dig Safe) law's definitions.

relevant_sections.heading: Rulemaking
relevant_sections.plain_language: Moved Dig Safe rulemaking from the commission to the department - the excavation-safety rules protecting buried gas and electric lines.

relevant_sections.heading: Civil Penalty
relevant_sections.plain_language: Conforming change to Dig Safe civil penalties.

relevant_sections.heading: Renewable Energy and Energy Efficiency Project Loan Programs
relevant_sections.plain_language: Moved the renewable energy and energy efficiency project loan programs (business finance authority lending) to the department.

relevant_sections.heading: Electric Utility Restructuring; Purpose
relevant_sections.plain_language: Conforming change to the electric utility restructuring purpose statute.

relevant_sections.heading: New Paragraph; Definitions
relevant_sections.plain_language: Added a department definition to the restructuring chapter.

relevant_sections.heading: Restructuring Policy Principles; Implementation
relevant_sections.plain_language: Amended the electric utility restructuring policy principles (RSA 374-F:3) and their implementation - the ground rules of New Hampshire's competitive electricity market, including how energy efficiency programs and the system benefits charge are administered.

relevant_sections.heading: Electric Utility Restructuring; Ratepayer Protection
relevant_sections.plain_language: Rewrote the restructuring chapter's ratepayer-protection provisions - who watches that restructuring savings reach customers.

relevant_sections.heading: Oversight Committee; Report
relevant_sections.plain_language: Conforming change to the restructuring oversight committee's reporting.

relevant_sections.heading: Competitive Electricity Supplier Requirements; Participation in Regional Activities
relevant_sections.plain_language: Moved competitive electricity supplier registration and regional-activities participation to the department.

relevant_sections.heading: Offshore Wind and Port Development; Commission Established; Membership
relevant_sections.plain_language: Moved the offshore wind and port development commission under the new department's leadership - the state's standing body on Gulf of Maine offshore wind.

relevant_sections.heading: Reference Changed; Office of Offshore Wind Industry Development
relevant_sections.plain_language: Renamed the office of offshore wind industry development under the department.

relevant_sections.heading: Definitions Amend RSA 374-H:1, I to read as follows: I
relevant_sections.plain_language: Conforming definitions change for the multi-use energy data chapter (RSA 374-H).

relevant_sections.heading: Investigation of Energy Storage
relevant_sections.plain_language: Turned the energy storage docket into a department investigation: how storage projects get paid for avoided transmission and distribution costs - the grid-modernization question behind peak-demand costs.

relevant_sections.heading: Fixing of Rates by Commission; Energy Policy Act Standards
relevant_sections.plain_language: Conforming change to rate-fixing procedures and federal Energy Policy Act standards review.

relevant_sections.heading: Contracts for Advertising
relevant_sections.plain_language: Conforming change to utility advertising-contract rules (RSA 378:24).

relevant_sections.heading: Filing; Inspection; Temporary Rates
relevant_sections.plain_language: Conforming change to rate filing, inspection, and temporary-rate procedures.

relevant_sections.heading: Multi-use Data Energy Platform
relevant_sections.plain_language: Rewrote the multi-use energy data platform statute (RSA 378:50-52): the shared platform giving customers and competitive suppliers access to electric and gas usage data - the infrastructure that time-of-use rates and smart-meter programs depend on.

relevant_sections.heading: Regional Greenhouse Gas Initiative; Energy Efficiency Fund and Use of Auction Proceeds
relevant_sections.plain_language: Moved the Regional Greenhouse Gas Initiative energy efficiency fund to the department and re-enacted how RGGI auction proceeds are used - most consumer proceeds rebated on electric bills, with a set-aside funding low-income energy efficiency programs.

relevant_sections.heading: Department of Energy; Position Transferred
relevant_sections.plain_language: Transferred a business-systems position into the Department of Energy.

relevant_sections.heading: Office of the Consumer Advocate; Transfer Authority
relevant_sections.plain_language: Gave the Office of the Consumer Advocate authority to transfer funds between expenditure classes - budget flexibility for the ratepayers' advocate.

relevant_sections.heading: Public Utilities; Assessment
relevant_sections.plain_language: Rewrote the public utilities assessment (RSA 363-A): how the costs of the Department of Energy and PUC are assessed against regulated utilities - the mechanics of who pays for utility regulation.

relevant_sections.heading: Public Utilities; Certification of Assessment

relevant_sections.heading: Expenses of Public Utilities Commission; Collections
relevant_sections.plain_language: Collection mechanics for the assessment.

relevant_sections.plain_language: Exempted the smallest utilities (under $150,000 of annual revenue) from the regulatory assessment.

relevant_sections.heading: Appropriation; Department of Energy; Establishment of the Regional Energy Advocacy Fund
relevant_sections.plain_language: Created the Regional Energy Advocacy Fund with a $250,000 appropriation: money for the state to advocate in regional (ISO-New England and federal) energy proceedings, where wholesale prices are actually set.

relevant_sections.heading: Department of Energy; Commissioner; Deputy Commissioner; Directors; General Counsel
relevant_sections.plain_language: Restated the Department of Energy's leadership structure (commissioner, deputy, directors, general counsel).

relevant_sections.heading: Legislative Findings
relevant_sections.plain_language: Legislative findings on electric vehicles: EVs pay no gas tax, so the trailer's registration-fee sections frame road funding as the issue.

relevant_sections.heading: New Section; Vehicle Registration Fee to be Collected
relevant_sections.plain_language: Created the electric vehicle registration surcharge (RSA 261:141-b): $100 a year for battery-electrics and $50 for plug-in hybrids in lieu of gas taxes - the state's first EV-specific charge.

relevant_sections.heading: Appropriation; Support of Regional Fisheries Alongside Offshore Wind Energy Development
relevant_sections.plain_language: Appropriated $10,000 for New Hampshire's share of the 11-state regional fisheries effort alongside offshore wind development - the state's seat at the table as Gulf of Maine wind advances.

relevant_sections.heading: Appropriation; Business Network for Offshore Wind Membership
relevant_sections.plain_language: Appropriated $30,000 for three years of state membership in the Business Network for Offshore Wind - the supply-chain and industry-development side of offshore wind.

relevant_sections.heading: Department of Energy; Study on Graduated Public Assistance Mandated
relevant_sections.plain_language: Ordered the Department of Energy to study a graduated, proportional low-income home energy assistance program for households that earn too much for existing fuel assistance - the benefits-cliff study on heating help.
